description: Preview tracking an immutable Explore selection's searches under one Topic on the chosen platforms and cadence, without tracking anything. Returns the server plan, its planFingerprint, searches already tracked on another cadence (cadenceChanges) and whether confirmation is required.

body.description: Optional complete canonical activationPreview body; explicit fields override it.

cadence.description: Refresh cadence; defaults to weekly. Each refresh is charged when it collects.

sourcePlatforms.description: Platforms to track the selected searches on, for example ["tiktok"].

topicName.description: Topic the selected searches are tracked under; an existing Topic with this name is reused.

name: socialseal_explore_preview_activation
title: Preview Explore activation
